items.name: Leutenegger/vanity-eth
items.full_text: Offline vanity address generator for Bitcoin and Ethereum. CPU multi-process search with interactive CLI menu. Supports Legacy, Nested SegWit, Native SegWit, Taproot, and ETH (EIP-55).

items.name: Leutenegger/coldcard-airgap
items.full_text: Offline utilities for Coldcard hardware wallet users: PSBT inspection, BIP39/dice entropy, Seed XOR split/combine, BBQr encode/decode, output descriptors, and firmware verification guidance. Companion to official Coldcard firmware. Not affiliated with Coinkite.

items.name: xdreizein666/getcontact-cli
items.full_text: GetContact CLI adalah project Python untuk melakukan lookup nomor telepon lewat API GetContact, tanpa aplikasi Android dan tanpa browser.

items.name: cclank/lanshu-create-ai-presenter-video
items.full_text: Provider-neutral Codex Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from a script and an authorized presenter image.

items.name: Neofollower/Neofollower-SMM-Reseller-API-for-Woocommerce
items.full_text: Official NeoFollower WordPress plugin for selling SMM reseller services through WooCommerce with automated API order fulfillment, service sync, status tracking and balance monitoring.
